body.name: Canonical semantic-separation radius certificate
body.construction: Run the total component and point selections defining \(i_*\) and \(u_*\). For every rival component, use the first violated rational row and a rational upper enclosure of its \(\Sigma_0\)-norm to compute \(\rho_{v,b}\), using zero if no row is violated. Set \(\rho_0\) to the minimum of these receipts and one, and set \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\).
inputs: the completed rational tangent component geometry
